title: Agent user simulation campaign
goal: Run a continuing non-destructive isolated-staging persona simulation across every shipped core web, iOS, and Android journey, including one complete event and a multi-stop tour, and route verified improvements into bounded domain tasks.

in: Create and maintain the isolated-staging runbook for synthetic agent-user simulations.
Define the worker, artist, venue manager, organization manager, platform admin, and customer journey matrix.
Record additive fixture rules, campaign-owned identity requirements, finding format, evidence paths, and task-routing rules.
Pilot one cross-actor chain before expanding to the full matrix.
Maintain a row-level persona × goal × platform × scenario coverage ledger and visible-shipping inventory.
Run a single-event and multi-stop tour from creation through completion with cross-actor evidence.
Route and rerun bounded domain fixes until all shipped core journeys pass with no open P0/P1.
out: Resetting, deleting, truncating, or destructively cleaning any database or production data.
Running production payments or using non-test payment provider configuration.
Granting platform admin access based only on an engineering agent name.
Implementing product fixes discovered by the campaign; those must become separate bounded tasks.
Claiming mobile or web pass from static route inspection or local-only tests.
Using demo.tourify.live before isolation from production is verified.

acceptance_criteria: Runbook defines isolated staging, synthetic campaign-owned actors, credential handling, additive fixture constraints, and payment test-mode requirements.
Runbook distinguishes engineering service identities from synthetic app logins and forbids implicit admin grants.
Runbook covers cross-actor dependency order, per-actor goals, negative/empty/error/mobile/accessibility scenarios, evidence capture, finding IDs, and task routing.
Campaign evidence template exists under docs/audits/flow-notes/ and can record pilot results, bypasses, defects, and follow-up tasks.
Simulation agents use a failure loop, learning ledger, and finding-to-fix packets so every roadblock records the optimal outcome, necessary fix, owner, acceptance criteria, and rerun scenario.
No database reset, destructive cleanup, production payment action, or seed mutation of non-campaign users is introduced.
Every shipped core web, iOS, and Android actor journey has applicable row-level evidence; no unrun or bypassed row counts as passed.
A single event and multi-stop tour pass creation, planning, publishing, sales, staffing, execution, and close with both sides of each handoff verified.
All P0/P1 findings are verified closed, P2/P3 findings have owned bounded tasks, and exact-SHA evidence is linked to QA-003 and QA-006.
